author: fourdogslong
name: MD3 Dark
description: A Material Design 3 inspired dark theme for darktable, with dark side panels around a mid-grey working area and card-style modules. Originaly from CritLoren, modified by fourdogslong.
notes: Ships as a zip instead of a single css file: extract it into the themes folder so md3-dark.css and its md3 folder sit side by side. The theme also imports darktable's stock darktable.css, so copy that file from your darktable installation into the same themes folder.
